findings.claim: After loading only the current event participants' selectedSlots, the new cleanup call deletes every selectedSlots row for the same eventType whose id is not in that filtered result set. Because the preceding findMany is scoped by `userId: { in: users.map(...) }`, any active hold for the same event type created by a different user/session is absent from `selectedSlots` and will be deleted here. This breaks concurrent reservations by clearing unrelated users' temporary slot holds whenever getSchedule runs.
findings.title: Cleanup query deletes active selected slots belonging to other users
